scope: Repair confirmed Composio actions for single-account sessions and remove the idle Browser Operator workspace strip without removing explicit extension pairing.

keep: Existing one-time approval, tenant-bound account binding, egress admission, and extension pairing capability
extend: Pre-dispatch Composio session-mode and active-account verification
Synthetic positive and negative action-selection tests
replace: Unconditional explicit account field on Composio session execute

schemaImpact.rollout: Deploy compatible Cloud Run API and frontend only after source-bound checks; no database migration.
schemaImpact.rollback: Restore the prior Cloud Run revision and Vercel deployment if connected actions or pairing regress; do not replay uncertain writes.

auth.description: The existing authenticated session and approval remain mandatory.

tenant.description: Connected-account list must match the exact authenticated Composio user and approved account.

approval.description: No email or other write executes without the existing one-time confirmation.

credentials.description: Existing protected Composio key is reused; no credential value is logged or copied.

egress.description: One bounded read of active connected-account metadata precedes single-account dispatch; execution remains on the fixed Composio host.

cost.description: Single-account writes perform one extra Composio metadata read; no premium tool or model is added.

tests.scope: Confirmed Gmail dispatch with one account and explicit multi-account selection
Idle Browser Operator is absent from workspace rendering

tests.command: Provider diagnostic with empty, non-sending Gmail arguments
tests.scope: Composio rejects the explicit account field with HTTP 400 and accepts its omission into the tool validator

architecture.reason: Repairs the existing Composio adapter and dashboard UI without a second action executor or approval path.

rollout: Run source-bound CI and stage the API and frontend; verify authenticated account selection and browser pairing before promotion.
rollback: Restore previous API/frontend revisions. A failed or uncertain send must never be retried automatically.
knownGaps: A real email was not sent during diagnosis; the user must authorize a fresh exact confirmation after deployment.
placeholderClaimsRemaining: No live end-to-end Gmail send is claimed before an authorized verified receipt.

blockers: Source-bound CI and staged authenticated verification pending
